youtube.label: YouTube
youtube.text: For YouTube: a strong hook, clear sections, an outro that invites the next video.

shorts.label: Shorts
shorts.text: For Shorts: hook in the first second, one idea, under 45 seconds, punchy pacing.

tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.text: For TikTok: conversational, fast cuts, on-screen-text moments, end on a question.

explainer.label: Explainer
explainer.text: Explainer tone: patient, concrete examples, no jargon without a one-line definition.

casual.label: Casual
casual.text: Casual tone: first person, contractions, like telling a friend.

emptyBody: Describe an idea above and Generate — or start from a template:

templates.label: Explainer — why octopuses have three hearts
templates.scaffold: Why octopuses have three hearts. Hook in the first two seconds, three quick facts, punchy outro. Curious, energetic narration.

templates.label: Shorts hook — 3 sleep myths, fast cuts
templates.scaffold: Three sleep myths everyone believes. Fast cuts, bold on-screen text, myth-then-truth rhythm. Confident narration.

templates.label: Product teaser — 30s launch video
templates.scaffold: A 30-second teaser for a new product launch. Sleek close-ups, rising energy, one-line value pitch, end on the logo.

deleteMessage: Removes this project and all generated media from this machine. Running jobs are cancelled. This can't be undone.
deleteToolMessage: Removes this quick tool output and the file it generated. If it is still generating, that stops. This can't be undone.
